note: Both sets cover essentially the same 15 claims and share the same defects: the 3/4" bolt quote inserts a '3"' that is a separate dimension (not part of the 'WELDED TO WIDE FLANGE' note), the '1'-0" MAX OPENING' quote contradicts the text layer ('1'-0" MIN' alongside '6" MAX OPENING'), and the (4) 3/4" holes are bound to a 'deck opening plate' although they appear in the foundation detail. Set A is more faithful in naming the components: it binds PL5x4x3/8 and the 3" std. pipe to the PV attachment detail (A1), where the page supports that binding, while Set B leaves them as generic 'plate' and 'pipe'. Set A therefore has fewer vague claims with no additional errors.
remarks: Both sets miss the general sheet note 'TYPICAL DECK REINFORCEMENT FOR DECK OPENING GREATER THAN 6" DIA.', which is the key applicability condition for the deck reinforcement details. The dimension callouts around the openings ('6" MIN', '6" MAX OPENING', '1'-0" MIN') are jumbled in the text layer and ambiguous in the image; both sets resolved them into '1'-0" MAX OPENING', which the text layer does not support. The '3"' near the bolt note is a separate dimension line and should not be folded into the welded-to-wide-flange condition. Minor: 'fitted stiffener | thickness | 3/8"' and 'plate | PL5X3/8' in both sets likely describe the same plate (FITTED STIFFENER PL5X3/8).
